title: Bounce heights with e = 0.5
caption: Each bounce keeps e² = 0.25 of the previous height: 1, 0.25, 0.0625, 0.015625, … infinitely many bounces, yet a finite total time (Zeno behaviour).
alt: Bounce heights 1, 0.25, 0.0625, 0.015625 metres with the constant ratio 0.25 between them.
description: The ball is dropped from 1 m.
Each impact multiplies the speed by e = 0.5, so the height by e² = 0.25.
Heights 1, 0.25, 0.0625, …: a geometric sequence with ratio 0.25, and infinitely many bounces.
